name: Anura Kumara Dissanayake
current_role: President of Sri Lanka / NPP Leader
bio: Political leader elected on strong mandate for institutional integrity, procurement transparency, and equitable debt restructuring for lower-income households.

stances.Tax Reform: Lowering PAYE brackets for essential workers, raising corporate wealth taxes & digital tax evasion enforcement.
stances.IMF Agreement: Commitment to debt sustainability while renegotiating poverty line threshold parameters for welfare grants.
stances.Anti-Corruption: Independent CIABOC empowerment, full asset declarations on public digital ledger, recovery of stolen assets.
stances.Energy Policy: Competitive tender for renewable projects, unbundling transmission without privatizing national distribution monopolies.
stances.Education: Increasing public education allocation toward 4.5% of GDP over 5-year medium-term framework.

news_articles.title: President Dissanayake Directs Treasury to Expand Fertilizer Subsidies for Yala Season
news_articles.summary: President Anura Kumara Dissanayake instructed the Ministry of Finance to disburse 25,000 rupee per-hectare grants directly to farmer bank accounts, bypassing administrative delays.
news_articles.sentiment_reason: Direct welfare relief addressing agrarian debt distress and improving seasonal food output.
news_articles.media_quote: We will ensure agricultural inputs reach farmers before tilling begins, without bureaucratic middlemen.

news_articles.title: Opposition Questions PACE of SOE Restructuring and Commercial Tax Revisions
news_articles.summary: Opposition MPs criticized the administration for delay in finalizing the state-owned enterprise (SOE) restructuring framework under the IMF EFF benchmark.
news_articles.sentiment_reason: Critique over economic policy pace and potential risk to bilateral credit rating momentum.
news_articles.media_quote: Delays in state enterprise decisions risk prolonging fiscal deficits.

news_articles.title: Asset Declarations of All Cabinet Ministers Published on Open Public Portal
news_articles.summary: Under executive directive, all appointed ministers and provincial leaders uploaded audited asset declarations to the digital CIABOC ledger.
news_articles.sentiment_reason: Landmark transparency initiative fulfilling anti-corruption campaign pledge.
news_articles.media_quote: Public office is a public trust; citizens have an absolute right to inspect asset evolution.

news_articles.title: Fisheries Harbor Modernization Program Launched in Point Pedro and Trincomalee
news_articles.summary: Government initiates multi-million harbor expansion with cold-chain storage facilities for coastal artisanal fishermen.
news_articles.sentiment_reason: Regional infrastructure investment boosting coastal exports and artisanal incomes.
news_articles.media_quote: Regional parity demands that northern and eastern coastal facilities match western standards.

public_media_statements.statement: We will establish an open electronic procurement system for all state tenders above 50 million rupees and make CIABOC completely independent.

parliamentary_match.note: Government tabled Draft Procurement Transparency Regulations in Parliament during December 2024 sitting.

public_media_statements.statement: The government will adjust the initial tax-free personal allowance threshold to relieve middle-income wage earners.

parliamentary_match.note: Tax schedules submitted to Committee on Public Finance (COPF) for fiscal impact review.

name: Sajith Premadasa
bio: Leader of the parliamentary opposition focusing on targeted grassroots interventions, smart classrooms, export promotion, and comprehensive safety net expansion.

stances.Tax Reform: Targeted tax relief for export SMEs, revision of the 18% VAT on school supplies and medicine.
stances.IMF Agreement: Social-market economic model with strict oversight on vulnerable household buffers and IMF conditionality auditing.
stances.Anti-Corruption: Special parliamentary anti-fraud taskforce with international tracing partnerships.
stances.Energy Policy: Rooftop solar democratization and subsidies for domestic micro-solar adopters.
stances.Education: Universal free midday meal scheme expansion and nationwide English/digital skills overhaul.

news_articles.title: Sajith Premadasa Expands 'Sakwala' Smart Classroom Drive to Rural Monaragala Schools
news_articles.summary: Opposition Leader donated modern computer laboratories and English-language learning software to 5 underprivileged schools in Uva Province.
news_articles.sentiment_reason: Grassroots philanthropic educational investment reducing regional digital inequality.
news_articles.media_quote: Every child, regardless of village or district, deserves access to AI, English and coding education.

news_articles.title: Treasury Benches Accuse Opposition Leader of Impractical Subsidy Demands
news_articles.summary: Government ministers argued that opposition proposals to slash electricity tariffs by 30% lack fiscal funding sources under debt agreements.
news_articles.sentiment_reason: Critique regarding fiscal viability and debt consolidation adherence.
news_articles.media_quote: Proposals without revenue offsets risk destabilizing sovereign debt sustainability.

news_articles.title: Opposition Tables Adjournment Motion on Escalating Cost of Living and Food Inflation
news_articles.summary: Sajith Premadasa led a robust parliamentary debate holding the government accountable on essential consumer price spikes.
news_articles.sentiment_reason: Effective parliamentary oversight safeguarding vulnerable consumer interests.
news_articles.media_quote: A parliament cannot stay silent when working-class families spend 70 percent of income on basic food items.

public_media_statements.statement: We demand guaranteed universal free breakfast and midday meals for all primary school children across Sri Lanka.

parliamentary_match.note: Raised formal question under Standing Order 27/2 regarding child malnutrition in estate sectors.

name: Dr. Harsha de Silva
current_role: Chairman of Committee on Public Finance (COPF)
bio: Economist and Chair of COPF known for pioneering public finance transparency, evidence-based legislative reviews, and social market economic frameworks.

stances.Tax Reform: Broadening the tax base via TIN-wealth linkages rather than regressive flat indirect sales levies.
stances.IMF Agreement: Strict adherence to Primary Balance targets while optimizing debt restructuring parameters with ISB bondholders.
stances.Anti-Corruption: Mandatory COPF scrutiny before all tax exemptions and strategic development project approvals.
stances.Energy Policy: Cost-reflective competitive pricing with unbundled utility regulator authority.
stances.Education: STEM voucher programs and private tertiary accreditation standards.

news_articles.title: COPF Uncovers Irregularities in Multi-Billion IT System Procurement Tender
news_articles.summary: Committee on Public Finance under Dr. Harsha de Silva flagged non-competitive deviations in Customs revenue digitization tender, saving estimated 1.2 billion rupees.
news_articles.sentiment_reason: Rigorous legislative oversight protecting public finances and promoting competitive bidding.
news_articles.media_quote: COPF will not rubber-stamp any project that bypasses standard national procurement guidelines.

news_articles.title: Dr. Harsha de Silva Calls for Urgent Modernization of 1990 Suwa Seriya Ambulance Fleet
news_articles.summary: Presented comprehensive operational sustainability blueprint to upgrade emergency telemedicine software and replace high-mileage ambulances.
news_articles.sentiment_reason: Evidence-based health policy advocacy for vital emergency healthcare services.
news_articles.media_quote: Suwa Seriya has saved over 500,000 lives; keeping it technologically advanced is a non-negotiable national duty.

public_media_statements.statement: Rather than continuously raising indirect VAT, Sri Lanka must interconnect vehicle registrations, property deeds, and bank TINs.

parliamentary_match.note: Delivered comprehensive COPF special report on automated tax compliance mechanisms.
